name: Living Ghost (Combat, Technique)
body:
Using the reach of the spear, you ward off a foe’s strikes before sliding the point inside their guard.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, weapon proficiency in a weapon from the spears weapon group, Weapon Finesse, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 shield bonus to AC against a creature who you have attacked with a spear in the last round who is adjacent to you. If a creature you receive this bonus against misses you with an attack, you gain a +1 bonus on your next attack roll made before the end of your next turn against that creature. This bonus applies only once to a given creature.
